categories.main_business_segments: Equitable Holdings operates through four main business segments: Individual Retirement (variable annuities for individuals), Group Retirement (tax-deferred retirement products for groups), Investment Management and Research (global asset management via AllianceBernstein), and Protection Solutions (life insurance and employee benefits). Certain activities not included in these segments are reported in Corporate and Other.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages actuarial modeling, dynamic and static hedging strategies, and reinsurance for risk management in its insurance products. Its asset management business utilizes proprietary investment research, quantitative and fundamental analysis, and a diversified suite of actively and passively managed investment strategies. Technology platforms such as EB360 support employee benefits administration, and digital tools are used for client engagement and advisor support.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include affluent and high net worth individuals (Individual Retirement and Protection Solutions), employees of educational, municipal, and not-for-profit organizations as well as small and medium-sized businesses (Group Retirement and Employee Benefits), and institutional, retail, and private wealth clients globally (Investment Management and Research). End markets span U.S. retirement savers, life insurance buyers, and global investment clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: Equitable Holdings primarily operates in the United States, with a strong presence in all 50 states, D.C., Puerto Rico, and parts of Canada for insurance products. Its asset management arm, AllianceBernstein, serves clients globally, including the U.S., EMEA, and Asia, with offices in major financial centers worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates downstream in the financial services supply chain, directly serving end customers with insurance, annuity, retirement, and investment products, as well as providing asset management and research services. It also acts as a distributor through affiliated and third-party channels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include ongoing product innovation (e.g., index-linked annuities, managed volatility funds), digital transformation for client and advisor engagement, expansion of less capital-intensive and higher-return products, and integration of ESG factors in investment management. R&D efforts focus on risk management, technology-enabled solutions, and adapting to regulatory and market changes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through a mix of fee income (from assets under management and account values), insurance premiums, investment income from the General Account, and policy charges (including mortality, expense, and surrender charges). Asset management revenues are primarily advisory and performance fees, while insurance revenues include premiums and policy-related charges.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In insurance and annuities, competitors include large life insurers, banks, mutual fund companies, and other financial institutions, with no single provider dominating the market. In asset management, AllianceBernstein competes with global investment managers, mutual fund sponsors, and banks. Equitable emphasizes its market-leading positions in variable annuities, VUL insurance, and global investment management, with a focus on product innovation and distribution strength.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2021, Equitable Holdings managed over $900 billion in assets under management (AUM), with $778.6 billion in AUM at AllianceBernstein and significant account values in retirement and insurance products. The company reported $2.8 billion in Non-GAAP Operating Earnings for 2021, with strong growth in asset management and stable contributions from insurance and retirement segments. The company has demonstrated resilience and growth despite market volatility and the impacts of COVID-19.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Equitable Holdings differentiates itself through innovative, customizable retirement and protection solutions, a broad and diversified distribution network, strong risk management capabilities, and a global asset management platform with a track record of investment performance. Its technology platforms, advisor-centric approach, and focus on less capital-intensive products provide competitive advantages in customer experience, product flexibility, and capital efficiency.
